purpose: Inputs for the suggested advance limit (cupo de anticipo sugerido). Every number carries its source. This is a transparent rule, not a credit model: it estimates expected production and applies the coop's haircut; repayment is deducted at delivery settlement.

yield_ref_t_ha.note: Reference soy yield at full condition. National average 2024/25 was 32.4 qq/ha (Bolsa de Cereales de Buenos Aires, cierre de campana); central-north Cordoba was reported above expectations. No department-level figure for Rio Segundo was found; replace with the BCCBA departmental average when available.

price.note: Pizarra Rosario soja 2026-09-11 (Infocampo). FX = dolar BNA venta 2026-09-11 (El Cronista). usd_t = ars_t / fx, rounded to 1 decimal.

haircut.note: Team policy (Notion v2): cupo = valor de referencia * condicion/100 * 0.7. Rojo blocks new disbursements regardless of the theoretical cupo.

benchmark.note: What a coop does today: a flat percentage of expected value for every member, decided by eye. Claim from the team's advisor; validate with a real coop before quoting it as fact.

policy_by_light.verde: new disbursements allowed up to the suggested limit
policy_by_light.amarillo: review: allowed with an additional limit defined at origination

reference_value_usd_note: reference_value_usd = ha * yield_ref_t_ha * usd_t = 100 * 3.2 * 364.8 = 116736 (computed by the service, not stored)
